title: Designated mixed use area: ground floor units designed for future non-residential adaption
text: Where development is located within a mixed use area designated within the local planning framework, ground floor units are designed for future adaption to non-residential uses.
notes: Applies by location (a mixed use area in the local planning framework), whether or not the proposal itself is mixed use. DG 4.14.2: increased floor to floor heights and universal access. Judgment; no floor height is set. Text checked against page 79 (pass 1).
